text:
sophia_marketing: Heads up: need a compact launch asset set for next week's webinar (Tue 9am PT): - 3 hero tiles (metric sparkline, cost vs latency mini-chart, quick flow for inbound lead routing) - 1 16:9 slide diagram - 2 social cutdowns (square + story). Brand needs to be tight. ETA: Tues AM. Can design take?
jake_design: @sophia_marketing got it — can you share the exact metrics and copy? also preferred color for the 'warning' band on cost chart?
sophia_marketing: Metrics: p50 latency 120ms, mean token cost $0.0018, throughput burst 600 rps. Copy for hero: `Serve smarter: cut token cost by up to 3x without latency loss.` CTA: `Register — Aug 2 webinar` Localization: en + fr + ja (small).
nina_brand: Looping in brand: use primary brand palette; no new iconography. For charts: use accent-2 for cost, accent-4 for latency. Avoid gradients on small tiles. I'll DM color codes.
figma_bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/inference-econ-webinar-assets — edit permissions: jake_design, sophia_marketing, nina_brand
jake_design: Thanks — jumping in. Quick Q on flow diagram: do you want `user -> routing policy -> model variants -> fallback` or keep it higher level? Also, any data viz templates preferred? I'll mock 2 variants.
owen_growth: @sophia_marketing For lead routing: we need the slide to include 1) web form CTA, 2) canary route to dedicated, 3) fallback to hosted. Also include required tracking params (utm_campaign=webinar_aug). Who owns sample event names?
sophia_marketing: Owens — event names: webinar_inference_econ_aug2; go with utm_medium=organic. Yes to the detailed flow on slide, but keep the social tiles simplified (CTA only).
jake_design: Uploading first pass in Figma within 4 hours. Deliverables: figma frames: Hero_A (metric sparkline), Hero_B (cost/latency mini-chart), Flow_1 (detailed), Social_SQ, Social_ST. I'll add notes with copy variants and export presets.
nina_brand: :thumbsup: keep typographic hierarchy as H1:Inter 700, H2:Inter 600. I'll check contrast for social sizes.
sophia_marketing: Perfect. Also need PNGs @2x and SVG for slide. Tiny ask: include alt text suggestions for each social cutdown. Thanks!
jake_design: Noted. Will include alt text snippets and a 'copy bank' with 3 short captions. Ping me in thread if any copy edits.
sophia_marketing: Appreciate it — tagging deadline again: Tue 9am PT for final exports. If blocked, escalate to @nina_brand.
